analysis: The PR changes only docs/developer/test.md. Head hunks: lines 99-101 add a per-shard CI lane (test-provider-K) routed via the CI runner routing guide, and lines 1371-1374 add that the routing test pins each routed job's lanes (one per provider shard), fallback, timeout and read-only permissions, and that release workflows stay on literal Blacksmith runners. Both are documentation of CI runner routing and test coverage. They add no code, protocol, key-handling, attestation, cache or authorization behavior, and no workflow or script content is in this batch. They therefore do not alter A-001 to A-019 or the trust boundaries TB-002, TB-003, TB-007, TB-011, TB-012 or TB-013, and do not affect T-041. The retained statements that release workflows stay on literal Blacksmith runners and that routed jobs keep read-only permissions are consistent with the existing guardrail and do not weaken it. The actual routing scripts (scripts/test-darkbloom-route.py), the CI workflow and the routing implementation that those docs describe are outside the supplied evidence. Whether the described per-shard lanes match the workflow matrix is unverified and would need review in the workflow and script files if they change in the same PR. No finding qualifies for this documentation-only change.
